name: print-social-red-testimonial-post-with-tower-collage-and-dashed-path
title: Brick-red grain post with blue title strips, a dashed route to a flag and a clock-tower cutout
whatItIs: A grainy brick-red post with two slanted blue banners with cream caps, a dashed cream wiggling line from a level label down to a dot with a Swiss flag, text about a prestigious school and a big cutout photo of a clock tower at the right.
whatItMeans: Proud and direct; the winding path shows a learner's journey.
techniques: Show progress as a dashed winding path.
Place a landmark cutout at the edge.
Use one red with blue and cream.

vocabulary.definition: A dashed line from start to end.
A title strip with angled edges.
A famous building cut from a photo.
A tiny flag marking a destination.
